name: KeywordLens

image.alt: KeywordLens interface showing keyword demand analysis for stock media platforms
image.caption: KeywordLens: stock media keyword demand tool

premise: A SEMrush for stock media: analyse searches across the major platforms to surface high-demand, low-competition niches so photographers shoot what actually sells instead of guessing.
warningSign: The entire premise rested on human photographers remaining the dominant supply. The tool optimised for what to shoot — a question that stops existing the moment anyone can generate the exact image on demand.
causeOfDeath: Generative AI went mainstream. The market for optimising what to shoot stopped existing overnight. Not a slow fade. The ground moved.
survivingInsight: The demand-gap analytical method is sound — it works wherever human supply can't be automated away overnight. The lesson isn't about stock photography. It's about knowing whether your market has that kind of floor before you bet on it.
body: A SEMrush for stock media. It analyzed searches across the major stock platforms to surface high-demand, low-competition niches, so photographers could shoot what actually sells instead of guessing.

It died the month generative AI went mainstream. The whole premise was helping people find the right photo to shoot. When anyone could generate the exact image they needed on demand, the market I was optimizing for stopped existing. Not a pivot. The ground moved.
lesson: you can execute well and still be on the wrong side of a shift you didn't see coming. Timing isn't a detail. It's the whole bet.
